For video editors, too, there are the new Premiere mobile apps. [...] Adobe’s flagship programs, like Photoshop, have undergone major AI makeovers, including recent developments like AI audio and soundtrack generation. This has been to the dismay of some of its creative customers who are wary of generative AI. This year is expected to be no different. But there are other tensions brewing, including Adobe’s $75 million settlement with the US Justice Department over subscription cancellations and new vibe-coded and free Adobe alternatives. [...] Adobe tech is also now showing up in ChatGPT and Claude; Disney is using Firefly to help design theme park rides. items.title: Google faces mounting backlash for controversial AI school policy - CBS News
items.summary:
Markey is asking Alphabet if Google will commit to allowing schools to turn off AI features and chatbots in K-12 student accounts while still allowing students to access Google Search. He also requested that Google disclose any research it has conducted on the impact of its AI tools on students' mental health.

Markey has requested that Google disclose any research or testing it has conducted on the safety of its AI functions and their impact on the mental health of K-12 students. [...] Google maintains that its policy change gives schools more control over how they allow AI into schools. An Alphabet spokesperson also told CBS News that Google's AI features are now so tightly integrated into search that it cannot offer the latter without also enabling the AI services. [...] Google faces mounting public pressure to change a new policy that would limit U.S. students' access to the internet giant's widely used search platform unless schools also offer its artificial intelligence-based education tools.

In a letter to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai on Monday, Sen. Edward Markey demanded that Google's corporate parent reverse the policy, which blocks search for K-12 student accounts that don't also provide access to apps such as Google Classroom.

Việc cử cán bộ đi học không chỉ nhằm bổ sung văn bằng mà hướng đến trang bị kiến thức, kỹ năng để trực tiếp tham mưu, triển khai và giải quyết những vấn đề thực tiễn về công nghệ thông tin, chuyển đổi số tại cơ sở. Mỗi học viên cần phấn đấu không chỉ sử dụng thành thạo công nghệ mà còn có khả năng tham mưu, đề xuất giải pháp, hướng dẫn đồng nghiệp, trở thành lực lượng nòng cốt thúc đẩy chuyển đổi số tại địa phương.

results.input: Bạn là gì và làm được những gì?

result.actual_text:
Tôi là trợ lý nghiên cứu AI. Tôi có thể hỗ trợ bạn thực hiện nhiều tác vụ như:

1. **Tìm kiếm thông tin & tin tức**: Tra cứu thông tin trên internet, tin tức mới nhất theo mốc thời gian.
2. **Tìm kiếm bài báo khoa học**: Tra cứu các bài nghiên cứu (trên arXiv), đọc và tổng hợp nội dung bài báo khoa học.
3. **Theo dõi & tìm kiếm mạng xã hội**: Tìm kiếm các bài đăng hoặc xem dòng thời gian (timeline) của tài khoản mạng xã hội.
4. **Đọc nội dung trang web**: Đọc và trích xuất nội dung chi tiết từ các đường dẫn (URL) mà bạn cung cấp.
5. **Định dạng & tổng hợp dữ liệu**: Trình bày thông tin đã thu thập được thành bản tin, danh sách hoặc báo cáo bài bản.
6. **Tra cứu tài liệu nội bộ**: Tìm kiếm thông tin trong các chính sách, quy định liên quan đến nghiên cứu và xuất bản.

Nếu bạn cần tìm hiểu hoặc nghiên cứu về một chủ đề cụ thể nào, hãy cho tôi biết nhé!

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics

[...] In another example of teleoperation, manufacturers are developing devices that enable technicians to remotely perform ultrasounds, the FDA said. Robotic devices include stereotactic navigation systems, imaging devices and endoluminal navigation devices. [...] The FDA is asking the robotics community to submit comments on the discussion paper by Jan. 5. Ahead of that deadline, a public workshop to discuss the topics raised in the paper is scheduled for Dec. 2-3.

items.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL - The Robot Report
items.summary:
Walden Robotics is using Isaac Sim’s photorealistic rendering to train and evaluate its general-purpose robot in virtual environments for manufacturing and logistics. Dexmate is exploring how coding agents can rehearse and refine manipulation strategies in Isaac Sim before executing them on its Vega robot. [...] Robotics developers are already putting NVIDIA’s latest technology to the test. A number of developers are using Isaac Lab 3.0 and Newton. At CoRL, Skild AI announced Scalable Throughput-optimized Engine for Embodied Learning, or STEEL, a new rigid-body physics solver built on Newton to accelerate robot training with Isaac Lab. [...] Nexuni is testing GR00T 2 for robotic laundry. Foxconn is applying GR00T 2 to factory automation for server manufacturing, and Siemens is evaluating it across industrial use cases.

MicroAGI is using GR00T 2, post-trained through reinforcement learning, to perform Ethernet cable swapping with a YAM robotic arm. Its agentic robotics approach automates the creation and calibration of simulation environments using Isaac Lab 3.0 and Newton, where the policy is trained.
